payload.claim: The task description explicitly asked for 'a paragraph on this refusal to the module docstring of saffron/scheduler.py, and a sentence to build_queue's [docstring].' The module docstring (lines 38-49) got its paragraph, but build_queue's own docstring (lines 1167-1209) still ends at 'stack=True orders and refuses on depends_on by _stack_order' with no mention of the new removed-name clash refusal. A reader who consults build_queue's docstring alone, the function's own stated contract, has no way to learn that it now also refuses on a removes/consumes name collision.
